PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
ServiceNow Developer with over 4.5 years of hands-on experience delivering scalable solutions across ITSM, Service 
Catalog, REST integrations, Platform Automation, and domain-separated architecture. Skilled in building enterprise-grade 
automations using Flow Designer, Workflows, Script Includes, and Business Rules. Strong background working across 
Incident, Request, Problem, Change, and custom applications, ensuring stable operations, optimized fulfillment flows, and 
reliable cross-platform eBonding integrations.

○ ITSM Modules (Incident, Request, Problem, Change)

○ Service Catalog Engineering 
○ Flow Designer & Workflow Automation 
● Scripting & Configuration: 
○ Business Rules, Script Includes, ACLs 
○ Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions 
○ JSON Payload Engineering & Data Mapping 
● Integrations & Automation: 
○ Service Bridge (SN ↔ SN Integrations)

○ Attachment Handling, eBonding Setup 
○ Postman — API Validation & Debugging 
● Analytics & Testing: 
○ Platform Analytics Dashboards 
○ Indicator Sources & KPIs 
○ Automated Test Framework (ATF)
